name: Citrus-Soy Glazed Strip Steak with Pineapple & Bell Pepper Rice

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ oranges
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 ½ small pineapples
3 red bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, juice oranges into a small bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the orange juice along with soy sauce, honey, oil, salt, and crushed red pepper. Stir to combine the glaze and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 tbsp honey
extra virgin olive oil
salt
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, pat steak dry with paper towels and thinly slice against the grain. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg striploin (New York strip) steak
salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add steak and half of the glaze; cook, stirring occasionally, until steak is just cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve pot and remaining glaze for later use.)
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Cut off skin from each pineapple; quarter, core, and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl with the green onions.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl.

Wipe the pot clean with paper towels, return to medium heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add green onions, pineapple, and bell pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until pineapple softens, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
When the rice is done, add to the pot, along with reserved glaze, and stir to combine.
To serve, divide pineapple rice and steak between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
